note: Account figures and settings the scanner uses (rules v7.7). balance = current account value from the ledger; base = $25,000 plus deposits minus withdrawals; phase = Proving or Pressing; rate = latest 3-month T-bill rate (FRED DTB3) as a fraction. Sizes come from the rules: Proving Medium 6% / High 10% of the balance, Pressing 9% / 15% (size_medium, size_high, press_medium, press_high override them). min_score = the lowest call score traded: 9 means a 9 is Medium conviction and must fit the Medium cap, 10+ is sized at the High cap. real_puts false = puts are shadow-only: no real put trades. fed_bias auto = the scanner's three Fed signals decide the Fed point (calls get it with 2 or 3 easing, puts with 0 or 1); calls, puts, both or none overrides them. open = the real positions, so the scanner can raise exit alerts: a list of {tk, cp, strike, exp (YYYY-MM-DD), qty, fill, inv (stock exit level), time_stop (YYYY-MM-DD), step_done (true after the profit step), high (highest option close since entry)}. This file is public, like the rest of the repository. The trading session updates it when the ledger changes.
